theme: Keeping cores from reading stale data
title: Per-Line Adaptive Coherence: Invalidate vs. Update Under a Traffic/Latency Cost Model
strategies: trivial: invalidate-on-write for every line (the textbook MSI baseline)
greedy: measure the whole trace's aggregate read/write mix, simulate ALL-INVALIDATE vs ALL-UPDATE once, and apply whichever single global policy is cheaper to every line

strong: exploit that per-line interconnect cost is additive/independent across lines -- locally simulate INV, UPD, and a small grid of reactive ADAPT(window,threshold) policies for EACH line separately and keep the cheapest, so write-storm-shared lines get INV, read-heavy-shared lines get UPD, and lines whose access regime shifts mid-trace get an adaptive switch that neither global choice can express
invalid: illegal policy tokens / non-finite adaptive threshold -> rejected before scoring
